Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 34

“Learn this by prostration, by inquiry, and by service. Those who know, who have seen the truth, will teach you knowledge.”

Three conditions, and the middle one licenses questioning. Krishna asks for humility and service, yet insists that asking is part of learning rather than a failure of it.
